# Finite Goods

Finite Goods is a fictional shop for six one-of-one objects.

The application runs entirely in the browser. React renders the interface, while a Go state machine compiled to WebAssembly handles reservations and payment events. IndexedDB persists the demo state, Web Locks protect competing updates, and BroadcastChannel synchronises open tabs.

The Stripe flow is a simulation. A browser redirect never confirms a payment; only the explicit webhook simulation can mark the reserved object as acquired.

Main pages:
- /: available objects
- /back-office: inventory and event log
- /about and /how-it-works: architecture and demo notes
